---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a creative idea to make this project even better!
title: "[FEATURE] <short description>"
labels: enhancement, feature
assignees: ""
---

## 🌟 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

Tell us what problem you're facing or what you wish you could do.

## ✨ Describe the solution you'd like

Paint a picture! What would the ideal solution look like? How would it help you or others?

## 🚀 User Story (Optional)

As a [type of user], I want [some goal] so that [some reason].

## 🛠️ Possible Implementation Ideas

Do you have any ideas on how this could be built? Share your thoughts!

## 🎨 Mockups or Sketches (Optional)

Attach any drawings, screenshots, or diagrams that help explain your idea.

## 📚 Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or references to help us understand your suggestion.
